chunks.text: Docker sandbox networking is disabled. Training code cannot access the external network.
The sandbox runs as a non-root user with bounded CPU, memory and process limits.
Verify the artifact SHA digest and registered byte length before exporting or trusting the saved file.
Independently recompute checkpoint test accuracy by restoring saved tensors and running inference on the matching seeded test subset.
Project memory is scoped to one project and its public experiment constraints. It cannot override the current request.
The root task and its children share one budget. Summing both root and child counters double counts usage.
Approval never automatically resumes a paused task. An explicit control action is required.
Small MNIST subsets are engineering checks, not a full scientific accuracy benchmark.
